# bookmatch — quality and operations for the in-place deployed recommendation service

> [!warning]
> **Current health:** `/api/health` reports `ok` when the service is up and the corpus is ready; any other status means the service is not healthy.

## Behavioral contracts

- **deploy is never silent** — `deploy.sh` aborts non-zero on any failure: no sudo ticket, failed restart, or a dead `/api/health` all fail loudly.
- **deploy only ships clean main** — `deploy.sh` refuses to deploy unless on the `main` branch with a clean tree and HEAD matching `origin/main`.
- **health is proven after deploy** — a deploy is healthy only if `/api/health` reports `ok` AND `corpus_ready`; anything else triggers rollback.
- **rollback is automatic** — `deploy.sh` rolls back to the last known-good revision if health checks fail within the health check timeout.
- **schema is never a side effect** — `storage.ensure_schema_ready()` verifies only and raises if `books.*` is missing; it never creates the schema at app start or test run.

## Health

The aliveness signal is the `/api/health` endpoint. A healthy response reports `ok` AND `corpus_ready`; `deploy.sh` requires both fields to consider a deploy healthy.

A FAILURE looks like: `/api/health` returns non-`ok`, or `corpus_ready` is false, or the endpoint is dead. `deploy.sh` treats any of these as a failed health check and rolls back.

What QUIET looks like: no incoming requests and no activity. This is normal for a recommendation service — absence of traffic is not a health signal. Only the `/api/health` probe determines health, never activity level.

## Policies & SLAs

| name | value | source config |
|---|---|---|
| health check timeout | 20 seconds | `deploy.sh` |
| index chunk size | 20 million rows | `scripts/build_index.py` |
| SQLite insert batch | 50,000 books | `scripts/build_index.py` |
| download timeout | 2 hours per file | `scripts/download_dataset.sh` |
| service port | 8092 | `deploy.sh` |

## Tests

Run: `pytest` (the pre-push hook runs the same suite locally; CI runs it on push/PR via `.github/workflows/tests.yml`).

The suite covers unit and integration tests. The suite does NOT cover the live deploy path — `deploy.sh` is exercised only by running it against aurora.

## Deploy & operate

Ship path: push to `main` → pre-push hook runs the pytest suite (ADR-0020 gate) → `deploy.sh` verifies clean `main` at `origin/main` → restarts `bookmatch.service` via `sudo -n` → proves `/api/health` reports `ok` + `corpus_ready`.

Restart command: `sudo systemctl restart bookmatch.service` (via `deploy.sh`, which requires a valid sudo ticket from `sudo -v`).

Rollback: `deploy.sh` rolls back to the last known-good revision if health checks fail within the health check timeout, and exits non-zero.
